text.en:
The following new sections are hereby inserted between sections thirteen and fourteen of Act
Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and twenty-seven:
"Section 13 (a). Any woman who is now or may hereafter be married to a citizen of the Philippine Islands, and
who might herself be lawfully naturalized, shall be deemed a citizen of the Philippine Islands.
"Section 13 (b). Children of persons who have been duly naturalized under this law, being under the age of
twenty-one years at the time of the naturalization of their parents, shall, if dwelling in the Philippine Islands,
be considered citizens thereof.
"Section 13 (c). Children of persons naturalized under this law who have been born in the Philippine Islands
after the naturalization of their parents shall be considered citizens thereof.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 30, 1928.
